examples.arabic: قلتلها انا مش طباخ بس عم جرب اكون طباخ في البيت اليوم
examples.english: I told her "I'm not a chef, but I'm trying to be a chef at home today."
examples.transliteration: Qultilha ana mish tabbākh bas ʻam jarrib akūn tabbākh fī el bēt el yōm

examples.arabic: انا ما بعرف كتير بس رح جرب
examples.english: I don't know much but I will try.
examples.transliteration: Ana ma ba'ref kteer bas rah jarreb.
